description: This file defines a serializer class for RDDOperationGraphWrapper objects in Apache Spark, including methods for serialization and deserialization of graph components and related classes, as well as a serializer for DeterministicLevel enum.

classes.name: RDDOperationGraphWrapperSerializer
classes.description: Serializer class for RDDOperationGraphWrapper objects, handling their conversion to and from byte arrays.

classes.name: DeterministicLevelSerializer
classes.description: Utility object for serializing and deserializing DeterministicLevel enum values.

methods.name: serialize
methods.description: Serializes an RDDOperationGraphWrapper into a byte array.

methods.name: deserialize
methods.description: Deserializes a byte array into an RDDOperationGraphWrapper.

methods.name: serializeRDDOperationClusterWrapper
methods.description: Serializes an RDDOperationClusterWrapper into its protobuf representation.

methods.name: deserializeRDDOperationClusterWrapper
methods.description: Deserializes protobuf data into an RDDOperationClusterWrapper.

methods.name: serializeRDDOperationNode
methods.description: Serializes an RDDOperationNode into protobuf format.

methods.name: deserializeRDDOperationNode
methods.description: Deserializes protobuf data into an RDDOperationNode.

methods.name: serializeRDDOperationEdge
methods.description: Serializes an RDDOperationEdge into protobuf format.

methods.name: deserializeRDDOperationEdge
methods.description: Deserializes protobuf data into an RDDOperationEdge.
